name: Events Pavilion
tagline: Weddings, reunions, and celebrations under a rustic, farm-style roof.
description: An open-air, barn-inspired pavilion surrounded by sugarcane fields and garden views - built to host our own family's biggest celebrations, and now open to yours.

highlights.name: Rustic Barn Styling
highlights.description: Exposed wood trusses, capiz-shell lighting, and long communal tables that feel like a family fiesta, not a rented hall.

highlights.name: Garden & Field Views
highlights.description: Open sides overlooking the Pick-and-Pay Garden and sugarcane fields, best enjoyed at golden hour.

highlights.name: Farm-to-Table Catering
highlights.description: Full event catering by G-Resto, from Chicken Inasal buffets to plated Negrense menus.

highlights.name: Sound & Lighting Ready
highlights.description: Built-in power, string lights, and open floor space for a stage, live band, or program.

notes: Ideal for weddings, family reunions, milestone birthdays, and corporate outings - ask about full-resort buyouts for multi-day celebrations.
